div.style: color: rgb(20, 62, 56) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 350px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(88, 63, 13) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 350px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(109, 38, 33) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 350px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Comparison only
No arbitrage label or automated execution

div.style: color: rgb(20, 62, 56) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 350px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Compute minimum combined payout
Across all permitted settlement outcomes

div.style: color: rgb(88, 63, 13) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 350px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(109, 38, 33) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 350px; text-align: center;

span.p: Explain why the candidate is blocked

div.style: color: rgb(20, 62, 56) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 350px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Compute executable cost at chosen limit prices
Quantity, fees, rounding and buffers included

div.style: color: rgb(88, 63, 13) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 350px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Minimum payout minus bounded cost
meets configured threshold?

div.style: color: rgb(20, 62, 56) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 350px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Persist paired execution plan
Reserve exposure for both legs
Set unmatched-exposure and time limits

div.style: color: rgb(20, 62, 56) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 350px; text-align: center;

span.p: Submit first leg through execution service

div.style: color: rgb(88, 63, 13) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 350px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(109, 38, 33) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 350px; text-align: center; width: 350px;

span.p: Stop plan; release only confirmed unused reservation

div.style: color: rgb(109, 38, 33) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 350px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Pause plan and reconcile
Retain reservation; no blind retries

div.style: color: rgb(20, 62, 56) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 350px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Size second leg to confirmed matched quantity
Recheck price limits, validity and exposure policy

div.style: color: rgb(88, 63, 13) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 350px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(20, 62, 56) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 350px; text-align: center; width: 350px;

span.p:
Record actual costs, fees and matched quantity
Report settlement-dependent payout and remaining exposure

div.style: color: rgb(109, 38, 33) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 350px; text-align: center; width: 350px;

span.p:
Record unmatched exposure
Pause strategy and reconcile
Apply only a pre-authorized bounded recovery policy

div.style: color: rgb(88, 63, 13) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 350px; text-align: center; width: 350px;

span.p:
This is coordinated execution, not a cross-market atomic transaction.
Grouping, concurrent submission or single-order FOK cannot prove pair atomicity.
